pages.title: World TB Day 2026 — towards person-centred TB care

facts.text: World Tuberculosis Day: March 24 — marks discovery of the TB bacterium by Robert Koch in 1882
facts.head: Day

facts.text: Theme 2026: "Yes! We Can End TB"
facts.head: Day

facts.text: Mycobacterium tuberculosis; airborne; mainly lungs but ⚠ also other organs
facts.head: TB facts

facts.text: 10 million+ ill, 1 million+ deaths a year; leading single infectious killer; ~one-fourth of world infected
facts.head: TB facts

facts.text: Untreated mortality ~50%; 4–6 months treatment cures ~90%
facts.head: TB facts

facts.text: Global target 2030 (SDGs, WHO End TB); ⚠ India's target 2025; UN High-Level Meetings 2018, 2023; next 2028; WHO Global TB Report since 1997
facts.head: TB facts

facts.text: NTEP bidirectional TB–diabetes screening; Chennai cohort — 34% of TB patients diabetic, 41% of them poorly controlled
facts.head: Integration

facts.text: Pilot: of 26,000 screened, ~3,000 had COPD/asthma
facts.head: Integration
